id: faq-1

en: We accept applications year-round where places allow; main entry is August. Popular grades fill early.
id: Kami menerima pendaftaran sepanjang tahun selama ada tempat; masuk utama Agustus. Kelas populer cepat penuh.
faq-2

en: Age-appropriate assessments and a family conversation help us understand each learner — not to rank them.
id: Asesmen sesuai usia dan percakapan keluarga membantu kami memahami setiap siswa — bukan untuk peringkat.
faq-3

en: Yes — ELL support is built into the program, with specialists on each campus.
id: Ya — dukungan ELL terintegrasi, dengan spesialis di setiap kampus.
faq-4

en: Need-aware scholarships are available through the Scholarship Fund; inquiries are confidential.
id: Beasiswa berbasis kebutuhan tersedia melalui Dana Beasiswa; pertanyaan bersifat rahasia.
faq-5

en: Absolutely — book a weekday morning tour and see classes in session.
id: Tentu — pesan tur pagi hari kerja dan lihat kelas berlangsung.
faq-6

en: Two years of school reports, a teacher recommendation, and a passport copy.
id: Rapor dua tahun, rekomendasi guru, dan salinan paspor.
faq-7

q.en: IB or AP — how do students choose?

en: Counselors help each student build a pathway from their strengths and goals; both are offered.
id: Konselor membantu setiap siswa membangun jalur dari kekuatan dan tujuan; keduanya tersedia.
faq-8

en: Typically 18–24, with smaller groups for specialized support.
id: Umumnya 18–24, dengan kelompok lebih kecil untuk dukungan khusus.
faq-9

q.en: How do new families get connected?

en: The PTA hosts coffee mornings each term and a welcome program for new families.
id: PTA mengadakan coffee morning tiap semester dan program sambutan keluarga baru.
faq-10

q.en: Can the community use the facilities?

en: Yes — courts, pool, and auditorium are available for hire outside school hours.
id: Ya — lapangan, kolam, dan auditorium tersedia untuk disewa di luar jam sekolah.
